brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: structure.derive
objective.description: Create one new derived structure descriptor in the local context from caller-supplied structure content and lineage.

#root.role: Build a new derived structure descriptor, preserve caller-supplied lineage, write it locally, and register it in the structure catalog.

target_structure_id._comment: Optional. Name for the derived structure within the current context. Auto-generated by the engine when absent.

structure._comment: Optional opaque derived structure descriptor seed. A brique section and kind marker are ensured when absent.

derived_from._comment: Optional. Lineage value stored as-is in the structure descriptor under the 'derived_from' key. Accepts any JSON value: a string, an array of strings (e.g. source structure IDs), an object, or any other JSON-serializable value. The engine does not interpret or validate its shape.

effects.structure_descriptor: A new derived structure descriptor is written.
effects.catalog: The local structure catalog gains the derived structure.

transformation_contract.morphing: A caller-supplied derived structure definition and lineage becomes a new committed local structure descriptor with explicit lineage carried in its descriptor and catalog presence.
invariants: If target_structure_id is omitted, the capacity generates a fresh local structure identifier.
The provided derived_from value is stored opaquely and not normalized by the engine.
Derivation creates a new structure entry rather than mutating an existing one.
success: On success, structure.derive returns ok=true, the concrete target_structure_id, and the committed revision.
Successful derivation writes the derived structure descriptor and registers it in the local catalog.
failure: The capacity refuses derivation when the designated or generated target_structure_id already exists in the runtime catalog.
The capacity fails when the structure descriptor cannot be marshaled or committed to disk.
notes: The engine does not interpret lineage semantics beyond storing the supplied derived_from value.
Structure content stays opaque apart from brique normalization and revision stamping.
